يفتتحون (form VIII)
# يَفْتَتِحُونَ (yaftatiḥūna) /jaf.ta.ti.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# يُفْتَتَحُونَ (yuftataḥūna) /juf.ta.ta.ħuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
